verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at help.puzzle.io (HTTP 200) indexing the help center. A puzzle.io llms.txt also links the ReadMe developer reference, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec downloads unauthenticated. Individual help articles are served as .md files, giving agents clean, agent-oriented docs to consume. Missing for 10: first-party docs presenting llms.txt as an agent entry point, a directly verified OpenAPI link (the spec isn't prose-linked and the probe of help-domain paths 404'd), and independent hands-on reports of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://help.puzzle.io/llms.txt # Puzzle Help Center
Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0) on its app domain
